semantic_reasoning: consequence after the developer patch: wrong result only, no sanitizer report. The patch packs 13 positional arguments and so closes the reported SEGV (poc_after.log; str_kw_n0 to str_kw_n14 OK in variants/after.cases.log), but the double push after gen_hash() in the n < 14 branch of gen_assignment() remains, so for 0 to 12 positional arguments []= receives the stale register that precedes the right-hand side (66 of 103 small-hash cases WRONG, 0 ASAN, variants/after.cases.log; o[1, k: 99] = :rhs gives [1, {:k=>99}, 99]). The stale slot is inside the declared register count and holds a tagged value, so no memory-safety consequence was observed or is expected; a C-defined []= raises TypeError at worst. The only sanitizer report still reachable on the developer build (kwbig_n13 to kwbig_n16, heap-buffer-overflow) is the gen_hash() final-branch defect recorded in residual, independent by the separability rule. Reviewed by a coauthor on 2026-10-14: the developer patch is correct against the huntr report; the stale-register defect is a flag, not a verdict. Review 2026-11-06: the user dismissed the flag as minor (a rare input: an index assignment with keyword arguments; wrong result only), under the rule of that date that a minor leftover or one in a separate logic system is not flagged; the developer patch is the reference patch, dev_patch_fixes_root_cause stays false as evidence and the root patch stays recorded.
semantic_status: dismissed 2026-11-06 as minor: the leftover, a stale right-hand side for []= with keyword arguments and 0 to 12 positional arguments (66 of 103 cases, wrong result only, no sanitizer report), needs an index assignment with keyword arguments, a rare input; confirmed on 2026-10-28; dev_patch_fixes_root_cause stays false as evidence
dev_patch_scope: stops the PoC crash (index assignment with 13 positional args and keywords) by packing the args before the keyword hash; the extra push remains, so 66 of 103 small-hash index-assignment cases (0-12 positional args) still pass a wrong right-hand side, with no ASan report (variants/after.cases.log)
root_cause: gen_assignment() pushes the keyword hash again after gen_hash(..., VAL, 0) has already pushed it (codegen.c:1914 at base), so the compiler stack pointer is one register ahead; with 13 positional args the final ARRAY starts one register late and mrb_get_args reads an Integer as the argument array
root_patch_status: accepted 2026-11-10 as a correct fix beside the developer patch (the more complete fix), not the reference patch: the adoption of 2026-10-26 as the reference patch for downstream tasks was withdrawn on 2026-11-06, when the semantic flag was dismissed as minor, so the developer patch is the reference patch; a patch equivalent to this one is also a correct answer for the instance
upstream_status: no upstream fix: no commit on any branch, tag or pull request head at 891d1d9dc (2026-10-12) changes the stack accounting of the keyword branch; master (Prism compiler, default since ca1ea88eb, legacy compiler removed in aad25e7d3) rejects keyword arguments in index assignment as a syntax error; the residual gen_hash() final branch is unchanged at master (upstream_search.log, variants/upstream_master.*)
root_check: developer patch lines unchanged plus 1 added line (pop() in the n < 14 branch); 103/103 small-hash index-assignment cases OK; compiled output of all 198 .rb files in the tree identical to base; ablation: dropping the added line leaves 66 wrong cases (R1), dropping the developer pair keeps all passing (D1, developer change redundant but kept); see variants.log, ablation.log
residual: gen_hash() final branch (codegen.c:1686 at base) builds the remaining literal pairs as a new hash (OP_HASH) without checking update, leaving the started hash as an extra value; update is set by a preceding **h or by a flush after about 47 pairs, so o[1, **h, k: 99] = :rhs passes two hashes, and with 13-14 positional args the heap is corrupted (ASan SEGV in iv_free at shutdown) on the base, developer-patch and root-cause-patch builds alike; calls drop keywords (f(1, **h, 15 pairs) gets 1); fixed by the gen_hash() line in variants/root_hash.diff (61/61 residual cases); still present at upstream master for calls; not in root.diff, inclusion pending team review (variants/<v>.residual.log, notes/mruby.cve-2022-1276.md)
note: manual run, first session; crash judged by ASan report, since secb repro always exits 0.
